en.hubeali:
Ibn Fazzal, from the one who informed him, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Zahaar does not happen except upon the similar place of the divorce’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ibn Faddal has narrated from the one who narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Al-Zihar can take place only in the environment of divorce.’”
